text:
Anna Chen: quick pass on the rules editor  insertion target is still ambiguous when multiple rules share priority. users expect a clear "magnet" indicator that shows exactly where the card will snap.
Mike R: yeah the current hover outline is subtle and the drop jitter makes it feel unstable. suggest a short easing animation + a dashed rail that highlights the insertion point so the eye can track it
Sophia Patel: UX idea: show an "impact delta" chip in the left gutter that updates live while dragging (e.g., +12 / -3 matches). helps folks understand the immediate effect of the reorder without saving :bulb:
Derek Li: validation copy is too generic. proposed phrasing: "Overlap detected 1 rules share matching signatures. Reorder or refine the rule signatures. Click 'Show overlaps' to focus the affected rules." actionable and points to the UI
Jin (designbot): a11y notes  announce "reorder started" and then "preview position X of Y" via a polite aria-live region. ensure the magnet target is reachable by keyboard and support MoveUp/MoveDown bindings. on successful drop announce "rule moved" without stealing focus
Mike R: implementation note: I'll prototype the dashed rail + magnet micro-interaction, include a tiny easing (120ms) and add the delta chip. Also wire the preview toggle named "Preview Draft" so users explicitly choose draft vs saved preview
Sophia Patel: simulator quirk: the preview sometimes reflects saved config after a quick drag. recommend showing a small "Draft vs Saved" badge and a compact diff view: saved order | draft order. that should eliminate confusion
Derek Li: for keyboard users I'll add Alt+Arrow nudges and ensure each move updates the live region. also will make the "Show overlaps" action focus the first affected rule and expand details
Anna Chen: copy tweak for overlap CTA: change from "Fix" to "Show overlaps" to avoid implying auto-fix. we'll draft microcopy for the delta chip: "+{n} matches in draft" and a tooltip "Estimated change based on sample set"
Mike R: ok I'll open a tiny PR with the rail + magnet animation + delta chip and a Preview Draft toggle.
Sophia Patel: I'll write the overlap copy and draft the diff UI mockups for the help card.
Derek Li: I'll add aria-live wiring and keyboard move bindings, then run a quick NVDA pass.
Anna Chen: plan: Mike -> visuals + toggle; Derek -> a11y + keyboard; Sophia -> copy + diff mocks. sync tomorrow 11am to demo. thanks everyone :sparkles:
